text:
elaine: Quick follow-up thread for yesterday's outage: vendor auth throttles caused model-registry reads to back up and a short 5xx spike on hosted inference. Opening actions + owners.

sam: thanks — any Dedicated customer impact?

elaine: Four Dedicated tenants saw latency degradation for ~30–50m, overall 5xx ~2.5%. No data loss. Chain: vendor returned 429s for token introspects -> registry client retried aggressively -> connection pool exhaustion and timeouts.

priya: vendor confirmed an unintended rate-limit rule push. They blame a rollout config, but we should assume recurrence risk until they prove remediation.

jon: I traced this to a repeating signature we've seen before (we're calling it "token-throttle cascade"). Pattern is: sudden introspect 429s -> retry storms -> downstream queueing. Treat as an incident class.

marta: filed vendor ticket VND-934 and asked for a written postmortem, quota correction, and a dedicated key. Also prepping customer comms draft.

elaine: Proposed remediation slate (prioritized):
- Urgent (P0): increase local token cache TTL for model-registry + add randomized exponential backoff on introspect retries (owner: priya, due: EOD+1).
- Near-term (P1): implement a token circuit-breaker with fast-fail mode to avoid retry storms; add metric for circuit trips (owner: sam, due: 2w).
- Near-term (P1): deploy a fallback auth proxy (feature-flagged) that can serve short-lived cached tokens when vendor is degraded (owner: sam & devsec, due: 3w).
- Vendor (P0): demand SLA credit, dedicated rate-limited key, and a corrective postmortem (owner: marta, due: 72h).
- Runbooks/Detection (P1): add an SLI/alert for token-introspect 429 rate + a synthetic canary that simulates vendor throttling (owner: jon, due: 5 days).
- Governance (P2): add this recurring incident class to the monthly resilience review and rotate a postmortem owner for the next 6 months (owner: elaine, due: next meeting).

priya: taking the urgent PR now. I'll bump cache TTL from 30s -> 5m, add jitter, and emit cache-hit and retry-saturation metrics. Will open PR and request review. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

sam: I'll draft the circuit-breaker design and prototype a lightweight auth proxy that can mint short-lived tokens using our KMS-backed signing key. Security tradeoffs: KMS usage + rotation complexity vs vendor backup key procurement. I'll work with devsec on controls. ETA: 2 weeks for design, 3 weeks for a feature-flagged canary.

devsec: will review proxy threat model and requirements. We should avoid static long-lived tokens. Recommend ephemeral signing with strict audit logs.

jon: will add detection rules: (1) thresholded 429 rate over 1m, (2) registry retry queue length, (3) increase in connection pool saturation. Also add a synthetic canary job that injects controlled 429s in staging to validate mitigations. ETA: 5 days.

marta: vendor ticket updated with request for dedicated key + postmortem. Drafted customer-facing status; holding until vendor response. Will escalate internally if vendor doesn't respond in 48h.

ops-bot: Logged to tracker INC-2089: https://tracker.internal/INC-2089 (items TOKEN-401, CB-402, PROXY-403, VND-934, RUNBOOK-404).

elaine: two process asks: (1) treat this as recurring — put on resilience board with a recurrence tag, (2) add an "action aging" rule so any P0 older than 72h is automatically escalated.

sam: scheduling a 30-min resilience sync weekly for 3 weeks and then monthly. Invites to eng-sre, eng-platform, infra, devsec, and customer-success.

priya: will add a staged deployment plan in the PR and create a canary job in staging that simulates vendor 429s.

jon: I'll add a checklist to the runbook for automatic mitigation: (A) enable cache override with higher TTL, (B) open vendor ticket template, (C) toggle proxy feature flag.

marta: will prepare external comms template and a short FAQ for CS.

devsec: noted for security review and will add required audit hooks to the proxy.

elaine: Final owner recap and dates: priya (TOKEN-401) due 2987730000; sam (CB-402 & PROXY-403) due 2988364800 & 2989017600; jon (RUNBOOK-404) due 2987695200; marta (VND-934 comms) due 2987681600. Meeting invites in calendar.

sam: ack.

priya: ack, starting work.

jon: ack, drafting runbook edits.

marta: ack, monitoring vendor response.

devsec: ack, will prioritize review.

elaine: Closing thread — we'll update INC-2089 with progress. Reopen if vendor responses or blockers surface. Thanks all.
